init.title: Add a phone
init.description:
Scan the code with your phone camera and download the APK from the GitHub repository.

![QR code to download the APK]({apk_qr_url})

[Download the APK from GitHub]({apk_download_url})

After installing the app, name the phone to create a separate pairing code.

Address from Home Assistant settings: `{server_url}`.

download.title: Pairing code ready
download.description: [Download QR code (PNG)]({qr_url}). Open the image on your computer and scan it with Family Tracker. Manual code: `{code}`. The download link works once and the code is valid for five minutes.

error.pairing_unavailable: Could not create a pairing code right now.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name between 1 and 64 characters.
error.invalid_interval: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 1440.

abort.unauthorized: Administrator access is required to create a pairing code.
abort.public_url_required: Set the public HTTPS URL in Settings → System → Network → Home Assistant URL → Internet.
